- fetch_page(url, max_chars?) — Read one web page as clean text, or a raw text / JSON file
- deep_research(question, max_sources?) — Research a question: several searches, many sources read, the best pas
- github_list_files(repo, path?, ref?) — List a repository's files (or one folder when `path` is given)
- github_read_file(repo, path, ref?, start_line?, end_line?) — Read a file from a repository (line window for big files)
- github_search_code(repo, query) — Search code inside one repository
- github_repo_scan(repo) — Overview of a repository: info, folders, README and manifests
- memory_save(text, kind?, repo?) — Remember a lasting fact, preference or decision about this user for la
- memory_search(query, repo?) — Search what is remembered about this user
- schedule_list() — List this user's scheduled tasks
- schedule_delete(id) — Delete a scheduled task
- schedule_create(title, prompt, kind?, recurrence?, repo?) — Schedule a task that runs by itself later and reports back in this cha
- sandbox_clone(repo, branch?, dir?, depth?) — Clone a GitHub repo into YOUR private Linux VM for this chat, to insta
- sandbox_exec(command, cwd?) — Run a shell command in the VM (bash, node, npm, python3, pip, git)
- sandbox_wait(id) — Keep waiting for a long sandbox_exec command and get its output
- sandbox_write_file(path, content, cwd?) — Write a file in the VM (creates folders)
- sandbox_edit_file(path, old, new, replace_all?, cwd?) — Edit a file in the VM by replacing an exact piece of text (must occur 
- sandbox_search(pattern?, glob?, path?, max?, cwd?) — Search the VM's files: `pattern` = regex inside files; `glob` = file n
- sandbox_read_file(path, start_line?, max_lines?, cwd?) — Read a file from the VM
- sandbox_push(repo, branch, message, dir?) — Send the changes made in the VM back to GitHub: commit everything chan
- github_create_pr(repo, head, base, title, body?) — Open a pull request FROM `head` INTO `base`
- github_merge_pr(repo, number, method?) — Merge a pull request
- make_media(kind, prompt) — Make a picture, a sound or a short video yourself (Sham's own media mo
- ask_user(question) — Ask the user a short question when something needed is unclear or miss
